title: Be an approved provider of an education and care service
what: Hold provider approval and service approval under the Education and Care Services National Law before providing an education and care service.

laws.title: Education and Early Childhood Services (Registration and Standards) Act 2011 (SA), Education and Care Services National Law (South Australia)
